hero.title: Control your business, optimize your finances, unlock your growth potential.
hero.description: BelloSuite is the modular invoicing and business management software (ERP) designed for SMEs in Tunisia. One solution to manage everything, in one place.

modules.title: A complete and modular solution
modules.description: BelloSuite adapts to your company's growth by adding new modules according to your functional needs.

stock.title: Inventory Management
stock.description: Real-time stock tracking, inventory movements, shortage alerts, multi-warehouse transfers.

commercial.title: Commercial & Sales
commercial.description: Local and export invoicing, purchase orders, quotes, expense reports, payments and statements.

hr.title: Human Resources
hr.description: Employee management, contracts, administrative absences, professional qualification.

payroll.title: Payroll Management
payroll.description: Generation of payslips compliant with Tunisian law, automated tax and CNSS calculation.

accounting.title: Financial Accounting
accounting.description: Ledger, trial balance, generation of the employer declaration certificate (TEJ 2026).

projects.title: Projects & Kanban
projects.description: Kanban project views, task management and comments, synchronized in real time.

maintenance.title: Maintenance (CMMS)
maintenance.description: Manage your equipment, plan preventive maintenance, and track your work orders in real time.

production.title: Production (MRP)
production.description: Work centers, routing, Bill of Materials (BOM), and production order execution.

features.title: What sets us apart?
features.description: We build our tools with the deep conviction that Tunisian business software can be both beautiful and ultra-powerful.

security.title: Privacy & Security
security.description: Your cloud-hosted data is segregated and encrypted per tenant.

support.title: Exceptional Support
support.description: Our team in Tunisia is by your side for continuous deployment and monitoring.

improvement.title: Continuous Improvement
improvement.description: Regular updates with new modules without impacting your current workflows.

pricing.title: Price-Quality Balance
pricing.description: An SME-friendly strategy. Pay only for the modules you need.

cta.title: Ready to transform your business?
cta.description: Join other Tunisian companies that trust BelloSuite to manage their daily operations.

pain.title: What are your Excel files really costing you?
items: Stock nobody really knows until inventory day.
Forgotten invoices, reminders never sent, cash sitting idle.
Customers scattered across a notebook, WhatsApp and three spreadsheets.
Hours lost every month copying the same numbers again.
pain.punch: It's not an organisation problem. It's a tool problem.

solution.subtitle: No jargon. Clear answers to the questions you ask yourself every day.
solution.punch: The result: hours saved every week.
